## D — Accuracy notes and source flags: insurance, financial responsibility, crash duties and the driving record
Every C and C2 fact cites exactly one physical handbook page from the selected range; nothing relies on outside knowledge.
The financial-responsibility page prints a DMV mailing address for the SR-1; the address is a service detail and was not taught [A01].
The SR-22 page refers learners to call or email the DMV; no contact details were copied [A02].
The speeding point list labels the four-point band with the words or more even though a five-point band follows it; the four-point band is taught as a plain range and the five-point band as the open-ended top band [A04].
Fines, coverage minimums and point values are statutory and isolated as dynamic.

corpus_stability.reason: The Nevada Driver's Handbook carries one edition line on its cover (DMV 700 March 2024) and one copyright year on its title page, with a short key-changes list; nothing in the selected pages suggests more than one rewrite per year. The edition is about two and a half years old at intake, so currency is held as freshness debt in part A.
